summary.text: José Menéndez is a Democratic member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 26 since March 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A commercial marketing executive by profession, he previously served in the Texas House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: José Menéndez received a B.B.A./B.A. from Southern Methodist University, according to Ballotpedia.
He has worked as a commercial marketing executive and as director of multicultural markets.
Menéndez represented District 124 in the Texas House of Representatives until March 4, 2015, when he assumed office in the State Senate.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Administration, Business & Commerce, Education and Senate State Affairs committees, along with the Committee of the Whole Senate.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
